items.title: Putter Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 27, 2024
items.q: I’m just reading a book about Louis Armstrong and he talks about that.

ctx.x: That’s right. And the first tune that I realized there were chords in it that I kind of knew what they were was “Perdido” which is one of the things we would play in those days. And I remember talking to the tenor player and telling him, “Look at this” and showing him I could play a C minor and then an F major and then a B flat — and he says, “Oh wow, I didn’t know that” you know. Because we were all just ear players, and it’s hard to believe, you know, it’s hard to believe. But I read a thing about some great…
I’m just reading a book about Louis Armstrong and he talks about that.
